baselines.name: Retinexformer

paper.title: Retinexformer: One-stage Retinex-based Transformer for Low-light Image Enhancement

checkpoint.existence: Official README identifies dataset checkpoint; binary not downloaded or hashed in this task

training.dataset: LOL-v2 Real official Train (689 paired images); all 100 TTIE validation pairs overlap
training.recipe: Current YAML: 256 crops, batch 8, 150000 iterations, Adam 2e-4, L1, mixup. Paper: 128 crops, batch 8, 250000 iterations.
training.legacy_selection: YAML validation paths point to official Test. Historical checkpoint selection and exact training log are not independently bound; do not claim legacy test-blind model selection.

baselines.preprocessing: RGB float32 /255; reflect-pad right/bottom to multiples of 4, unpad. Native 400x600 needs no padding. Default self-ensemble disabled; large-image split branch irrelevant here. Clamp [0,1]; original PNG export quantizes to uint8.
baselines.target_access: Dataset test entrypoint loads target before forward for scoring. With GT_mean absent/false, target does not feed the enhancement network or output processing. --GT_mean rescales output by target-gray mean / output-gray mean and clips, hence rejected. Future low-only exporter must avoid target loading entirely until all outputs are frozen.
baselines.repository_metrics: Default script PSNR from floating RGB MSE; SSIM uses uint8 images, Gaussian 11/sigma1.5, population covariance and valid interior [5:-5], averaged over RGB. Not identical to TTIE full-map reflect SSIM. Saved PNG is 8-bit.

modes.description: Official LOL-v2 checkpoint, GT_mean=false, self_ensemble=false; future TTIE low-only float exporter, same native geometry.
Reference mean changes enhancement; excluded even when reported as default paper comparison
Optional target-free eight-way ensemble, not selected for main

published_lolv2_real_context.convention: Original paper context; not a reproduced TTIE uniform-metric result

notes: Eligibility label is provenance/inference eligibility, not a completed reproduction. Exact binary hash and low-only export remain future work.
Current YAML versus paper iteration/crop mismatch and legacy official-Test validation must remain visible.

baselines.name: SG-LLIE

paper.title: Towards Scale-Aware Low-Light Enhancement via Structure-Guided Transformer Design

baselines.license: No project-level license found at inspected commit; vendored package licenses do not license the project

checkpoint.existence: NTIRE checkpoint exists as a Git blob and README external link. No official LOL-v2 Real checkpoint binding found.

training.dataset: Released configuration/checkpoint: NTIRE 2025. Paper also reports LOL-v2 Real; release does not bind that run.
training.recipe: Paper LOL recipe: 384 patches, batch 4, adjustment layer omitted. Released YAML is NTIRE 1600-patch configuration, not LOL.
training.legacy_selection: Exact LOL-v2 training log/checkpoint selection unverified; cannot substitute NTIRE checkpoint as matched LOL-v2 training.

baselines.preprocessing: Released test.py: input RGB /255 plus structure prior computed from low image only; reflect-pad both to multiple 32, eight-way self-ensemble, unpad, clamp [0,1], uint8 PNG. Actual test imports UHDM_arch.py. No LOL-specific runnable recipe bound.
baselines.target_access: Released NTIRE forward uses low image and its prior only, no normal target or PSNR feedback. Prior normalization is input-derived, not target-mean matching. Paper adjustment module is a learned train-time mechanism; no basis to label it test-target-assisted. Released LOL variant remains unverified.
baselines.repository_metrics: Released test.py saves images without scoring. Generic BasicSR metric functions exist but do not establish exact LOL paper quantization, border or scoring settings.

modes.description: Designated target-free LOL variant would omit adjustment per paper; no official matched checkpoint/config bound.
Target-free NTIRE inference exists; not a matched LOL-v2 checkpoint/recipe.

published_lolv2_real_context.convention: Published LOL-v2 Real context only; exact released LOL metric/inference binding unavailable

notes: Missing 2025 method blocks readiness independently of all other choices.
Do not claim all official weights are absent: the 51 MB NTIRE Git checkpoint exists.

baselines.name: SNR-Aware Low-Light Enhancement
baselines.license: No project-level license file or grant found at inspected commit

checkpoint.existence: Official README names LOLv2_real.pth in pretrained archive; binary not downloaded or hashed

training.dataset: LOL-v2 Real official Train 689; overlaps frozen TTIE validation
training.recipe: Training video_base3, test video_base4_m; low_light_transformer nf64. YAML batch4, 600000 iterations, Adam4e-4, Charbonnier. Dataset training path resizes to 608x400 despite GT_size128 config field.
training.legacy_selection: Train config validation path points to Train; exact distributed checkpoint training/selection log not independently verified.

baselines.preprocessing: Test dataset loads native RGB float and 5x5 blurred-low features. Official test4 bilinearly resizes image/SNR mask to H400 W608, restores output to original dimensions. TTIE main instead predeclares reflection padding to multiple16, native direct test()/network forward, then unpad and clamp; this exporter is planned, not implemented or tested. Two stride2 layers plus 4x4 feature patches motivate multiple16.
baselines.target_access: feed_data stores GT by default and script loads targets for metrics, but test()/test4 network and SNR mask use only low and blurred low. Future exporter uses need_GT=False and avoids target visuals. No target-mean rescaling found.
baselines.repository_metrics: tensor2img clamps and rounds to uint8, with RGB/BGR conversion. test_LOLv1_v2_real.py PSNR scores uint8; SSIM calculation is commented and variable set to 0, so script SSIM is a placeholder, not a valid reproduced SSIM. Generic util Gaussian-valid SSIM is not called there.

modes.description: Official checkpoint with predeclared target-free native pad/unpad exporter; adapter not yet implemented. Report as protocol adaptation, not exact test4 reproduction.
Official target-free forward but resize400x608/back; preserve for provenance, exclude from native-input main.
Official direct forward; fixed native padding needed for patch geometry, no metric-based mode selection.

published_lolv2_real_context.source: Original CVPR paper LOL-v2 Real table
published_lolv2_real_context.convention: Paper context; official inspected script does not reproduce its SSIM. Not TTIE measured values.

notes: Original official dvlab-research URL redirects to JIA-Lab-research canonical repository.
Native exporter needs a later non-test smoke run; no claim of bitwise equivalence to test4 resize mode.

baselines.name: LLFormer

paper.title: Ultra-High-Definition Low-Light Image Enhancement: A Benchmark and Transformer-Based Method

checkpoint.existence: Official LOL-v1 checkpoint; no LOL-v2 checkpoint/config found

training.dataset: Official LOL recipe is LOL-v1 485 train /15 test, plus separate UHD-LOL/FiveK releases; not LOL-v2 689.
training.recipe: LOL training128 patches, batch8,4000 epochs, learning rate1e-4 to1e-6.
training.legacy_selection: LOL-v1 test used as validation; model_bestPSNR name denotes historical supervised validation selection, not inference target assistance.

baselines.preprocessing: PIL RGB tensor [0,1], reflect-pad to multiple16, network, clamp, unpad, uint8 output; target-free input-only test.py. Full-frame official LOL route, not UHD patch test.
baselines.target_access: test.py uses no target/reference or quality metric to alter output. Separate evaluation.py scores saved files. Training validation checkpoint selection is distinct from test-time output selection.
baselines.repository_metrics: evaluation.py uses skimage PSNR and SSIM(multichannel=True) on RGB uint8; no Gaussian options, hence legacy default uniform7/sample covariance and version-sensitive API. Not TTIE Gaussian full-map float pipeline.

modes.description: No official matched LOL-v2 training/checkpoint recipe.
Official target-free LOL-v1 model exists; cross-dataset transfer would be separately labeled, not matched LOL-v2 main.

notes: No LOL-v2 number found in original paper; do not copy later unofficial retraining tables.
LOL-v1 versus LOL-v2 scene overlap has not been verified.

baselines.name: Zero-DCE++

paper.title: Learning to Enhance Low-Light Image via Zero-Reference Deep Curve Estimation

checkpoint.existence: Official checkpoint is committed as Git blob; binary not downloaded

training.dataset: External SICE Part1: paper 3022 images from360 exposure sequences,2422 train/600 validation; no paired normal targets used for optimization.
training.recipe: Paper512x512; code training resize512, batch8,100 epochs, Adam1e-4, scale_factor1. Exact checkpoint sample manifest unavailable.
training.legacy_selection: Epoch99 official artifact, no inference-time target or quality selection; SICE external data does not meet literal LOL-v2 official-train-only main stratum.

baselines.preprocessing: Default lowlight_test.py scale_factor12 crops H,W down to multiples12 (400x600 ->396x600), with bilinear low-res curve estimation. Future separately labeled external-data mode predeclares official supported scale_factor1, no resize/crop, native full frame. Eight shared-curve updates, RGB float input; export float before torchvision image quantization.
baselines.target_access: Zero-reference train losses and low-only inference; no target image, target mean or PSNR output selection. Input-dependent curve prediction is admissible. External data eligibility issue is not target assistance.
baselines.repository_metrics: Official test script saves outputs without PSNR/SSIM. Original paper metrics are not a bound LOL-v2 Real uniform-metric recipe; no own-paper LOL-v2 numbers recorded.

modes.description: Verifiable target-free external-SICE recipe; outside literal official-LOL-train-only main class. Research lead may authorize separately labeled external/zero-reference stratum later.
Target-free official script but crops full-frame border and uses external SICE training; not main.

notes: UNSUPPORTED here concerns requested matched-data use, not absence of official code/checkpoint.
If external-data zero-reference comparison is approved later, retain scale1 before any metrics. It still cannot fill missing 2025 coverage.

main_protocol.dataset: LOL-v2 Real official100-pair test; untouched in this task
main_protocol.selection: Freeze Ours and all baseline modes/checkpoints using train/validation only before official-test decoding. T022-C remains candidate, not replaced by T023-A.
main_protocol.execution: One official-test evaluation after configuration freeze; GPU preferred for model computation; no run authorized by this document alone.
main_protocol.reference_boundary: Export/freeze all images, decisions and hashes for all admitted methods before loading any normal-light test reference. References score only; no reranking, mode/step/checkpoint selection, output normalization or retries selected by metrics.
main_protocol.input: Native H400 W600 RGB float32 [0,1], no image resampling/crop. Architecture-required reflection padding then exact unpadding only; network internal operations retained.
main_protocol.output: Native full-frame RGB float32 clipped [0,1], freeze float artifact before display PNG quantization. No gamma/brightness/mean matching or per-image output normalization.

psnr.domain: float64 evaluation of frozen RGB [0,1], all pixels/channels

ssim.hash_basis: Git blob at base_main, without Windows checkout newline conversion

main_protocol.reporting: Only actually computed uniform-pipeline results enter experimental table. Literature numbers in separate context field, never reproduced values.
main_protocol.validation: All-689 supervised checkpoints require retraining on589 non-validation pairs before any fair validation comparison; no retraining authorized this cycle.
main_protocol.legacy_caveat: Historical official checkpoint validation/test monitoring must be disclosed; FINAL_TEST_READY does not assert historically test-blind checkpoint selection.
main_protocol.runner_status: Planned exporters only, no baseline code changed or executed
